Elevated liver enzymes—most commonly alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate transaminase (AST), alkaline phosphatase (ALP), and gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT)—usually indicate liver cell inflammation, stress, or injury . Common causes include `fatty liver disease, alcohol use, medications, and viral hepatitis`.⁠Mayo Clinic  +3[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF180Bp7_MpK2pkxaFLtvJqKPdtf6seCJTXbE1L-xeb9hsBGYGDEO1-vT1L-M5WDrH5iN1z8bV42WJTePbekcRxkWhtX1pQiVzH_ZExqXVW_ZkO1UDbP13fv0-af_qVv1jgeX8mVZ3eh_BOFBlD6sbcRwd2a_sdmKrfzk67Vr11CijJfZ9Ino-2sA51ug56A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1_Z7gyXs1LxOTFVNiOMWzxU-FRD0gayEq-pd0v2-MUZVmVIWrWz6m-SsSb8nt_71JUEcFZq_PNabPkDb3j79YMG_AHphQJ2Q51-q_WhTKVCLpu9UJ2qyO0cASlSYDbIEQ_Wr98TQFDdHC7tEcoU89IkRx2uYH7cVo4u9umkbzKmS1M7D)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1-tcKUAAOdyWZb8ZBCXqRJjCWvQsK8CQJey0P8ObB3a3oobmB1bAFmbfd__u7gx6wy5LNqICiAt6C0orrKJiZTLVlOy0OAdnVC032CAxy4u1XKHmC3rN-61hNJSEkwWkw5ksAcq00hbsyt9h1vsnW8lsQagKsULyui3Gaa3PBzSrENJjt3qyJbftBVR8rBvNGEwnI9hLhzn778GfFMpXJBVCjZnGRPLUDRH8eR4hOA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF17ZcgIgRCBR2KX4e8gdErKW9P5b6gCvS6ek4hu_8FEcpozmbokNHEyE-ayj0wbwWCnxn_E6sPifyZCh_isMFppGkcHysnx_e0k2313aaA94qrCeHrIxDeo5lLvBMsVmh2WgghR-Q0BmY8B8tJTNdRlrrGlVG6m9eKcYs3ob3)

### Most Common Causes

- **Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD):** Excess fat buildup in the liver, often tied to higher body weight, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, high cholesterol, or high triglycerides.⁠Banner Health[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1-tcKUAAOdyWZb8ZBCXqRJjCWvQsK8CQJey0P8ObB3a3oobmB1bAFmbfd__u7gx6wy5LNqICiAt6C0orrKJiZTLVlOy0OAdnVC032CAxy4u1XKHmC3rN-61hNJSEkwWkw5ksAcq00hbsyt9h1vsnW8lsQagKsULyui3Gaa3PBzSrENJjt3qyJbftBVR8rBvNGEwnI9hLhzn778GfFMpXJBVCjZnGRPLUDRH8eR4hOA)
- **Alcohol use:** Heavy or long-term drinking can irritate or damage liver cells and cause alcohol-related liver disease.⁠Neighborhood Gastroenterology & Nutrition  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF17_qgoGfMTTBSmxaTXevshDRvgON8OsIK_jCxSAkLp4jGXLfEfiWc3709cTzJ1s50c_WsF0D0ImCNGcUvCdWaWApGGKjWkWoRflocGWQ7woNICsEhkBHs1N9gD35EUSBDWSmt-PG1_xibZ5JSCzJqAgS5ZwUVGe02aHohKAPQhHUb5_iTf8xPPO2H44x7PTT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1-tcKUAAOdyWZb8ZBCXqRJjCWvQsK8CQJey0P8ObB3a3oobmB1bAFmbfd__u7gx6wy5LNqICiAt6C0orrKJiZTLVlOy0OAdnVC032CAxy4u1XKHmC3rN-61hNJSEkwWkw5ksAcq00hbsyt9h1vsnW8lsQagKsULyui3Gaa3PBzSrENJjt3qyJbftBVR8rBvNGEwnI9hLhzn778GfFMpXJBVCjZnGRPLUDRH8eR4hOA)
- **Medications and supplements:** Over-the-counter pain relievers (especially acetaminophen), certain prescription drugs (like statins, antibiotics, or seizure medications), and herbal supplements can raise enzyme levels.⁠Mayo Clinic  +3[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF180Bp7_MpK2pkxaFLtvJqKPdtf6seCJTXbE1L-xeb9hsBGYGDEO1-vT1L-M5WDrH5iN1z8bV42WJTePbekcRxkWhtX1pQiVzH_ZExqXVW_ZkO1UDbP13fv0-af_qVv1jgeX8mVZ3eh_BOFBlD6sbcRwd2a_sdmKrfzk67Vr11CijJfZ9Ino-2sA51ug56A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1-tcKUAAOdyWZb8ZBCXqRJjCWvQsK8CQJey0P8ObB3a3oobmB1bAFmbfd__u7gx6wy5LNqICiAt6C0orrKJiZTLVlOy0OAdnVC032CAxy4u1XKHmC3rN-61hNJSEkwWkw5ksAcq00hbsyt9h1vsnW8lsQagKsULyui3Gaa3PBzSrENJjt3qyJbftBVR8rBvNGEwnI9hLhzn778GfFMpXJBVCjZnGRPLUDRH8eR4hOA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAIBxCJF1x2xukB6-MizKMeaNQ-JWvCv5uG_XMfNzkryqBeSIgATNQvqjDGa-wBWL5BQk51MGNfSfsxsVqVPoBg0fvXwFJduo9DmFEDH4tEfsGY15IY3tZvCtPFPL5IdaxJqMpS3t82vR6UJD8UZgp7bKjPGY-nDo21XfmY2hQqX4eaQ1Ms6Z_UAaRQELlaa_3hmefMiHbP9ZsEJdeRpfUJPitoueHeMSvHmYuHfE86pw-S3uOZk6vb6Z603-s1rf8Er9zsTp6s7RIExJHZ7hbYV4LysU-A7ck5pb_WywqlDN_1eZ9zeWJ3qwvs371xIEKxFje3LtAB7DVTXuTMNantujixPzfxvoIVaumD6rU82nkRHirH4oO8pT5moT9RDc8M)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UVco0M7mpqs&t=59)
- **Viral hepatitis:** Infections such as hepatitis A, B, or C cause liver inflammation.⁠Mayo Clinic  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF180Bp7_MpK2pkxaFLtvJqKPdtf6seCJTXbE1L-xeb9hsBGYGDEO1-vT1L-M5WDrH5iN1z8bV42WJTePbekcRxkWhtX1pQiVzH_ZExqXVW_ZkO1UDbP13fv0-af_qVv1jgeX8mVZ3eh_BOFBlD6sbcRwd2a_sdmKrfzk67Vr11CijJfZ9Ino-2sA51ug56A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF17_qgoGfMTTBSmxaTXevshDRvgON8OsIK_jCxSAkLp4jGXLfEfiWc3709cTzJ1s50c_WsF0D0ImCNGcUvCdWaWApGGKjWkWoRflocGWQ7woNICsEhkBHs1N9gD35EUSBDWSmt-PG1_xibZ5JSCzJqAgS5ZwUVGe02aHohKAPQhHUb5_iTf8xPPO2H44x7PTT)

### Less Common & Underlying Conditions

- **Autoimmune and bile duct conditions:** Autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis, or primary sclerosing cholangitis.⁠Cleveland Clinic Journal of Medicine  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXzL914cIEPOIRdaF8rRw3Cttfayv_rUJIlzjjzMCwLGH3hb2D5eQHpf1eytndYKwZJpyRLoR1fliVTQwBUxIwbcixZjKhBASl-qELLS8xSIavKlKZ1baeZLzyjF-h)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAIBxCJF1x2xukB6-MizKMeaNQ-JWvCv5uG_XMfNzkryqBeSIgATNQvqjDGa-wBWL5BQk51MGNfSfsxsVqVPoBg0fvXwFJduo9DmFEDH4tEfsGY15IY3tZvCtPFPL5IdaxJqMpS3t82vR6UJD8UZgp7bKjPGY-nDo21XfmY2hQqX4eaQ1Ms6Z_UAaRQELlaa_3hmefMiHbP9ZsEJdeRpfUJPitoueHeMSvHmYuHfE86pw-S3uOZk6vb6Z603-s1rf8Er9zsTp6s7RIExJHZ7hbYV4LysU-A7ck5pb_WywqlDN_1eZ9zeWJ3qwvs371xIEKxFje3LtAB7DVTXuTMNantujixPzfxvoIVaumD6rU82nkRHirH4oO8pT5moT9RDc8M)
- **Inherited metabolic disorders:** Hemochromatosis (excess iron storage), Wilson's disease (excess copper storage), or alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency.⁠Mayo Clinic  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF180Bp7_MpK2pkxaFLtvJqKPdtf6seCJTXbE1L-xeb9hsBGYGDEO1-vT1L-M5WDrH5iN1z8bV42WJTePbekcRxkWhtX1pQiVzH_ZExqXVW_ZkO1UDbP13fv0-af_qVv1jgeX8mVZ3eh_BOFBlD6sbcRwd2a_sdmKrfzk67Vr11CijJfZ9Ino-2sA51ug56A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXzL914cIEPOIRdaF8rRw3Cttfayv_rUJIlzjjzMCwLGH3hb2D5eQHpf1eytndYKwZJpyRLoR1fliVTQwBUxIwbcixZjKhBASl-qELLS8xSIavKlKZ1baeZLzyjF-h)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF17ZcgIgRCBR2KX4e8gdErKW9P5b6gCvS6ek4hu_8FEcpozmbokNHEyE-ayj0wbwWCnxn_E6sPifyZCh_isMFppGkcHysnx_e0k2313aaA94qrCeHrIxDeo5lLvBMsVmh2WgghR-Q0BmY8B8tJTNdRlrrGlVG6m9eKcYs3ob3)
- **Other infections and conditions:** Epstein-Barr virus (mononucleosis), cytomegalovirus, celiac disease, thyroid disorders, heart failure, bile duct blockages, or liver tumors.⁠National Institutes of Health (NIH) | (.gov) +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXWGCgXMK2aJfd1MPF1BgecuTNld-HMQU-DgOV_6hPDvjgq8caWKObOo7PqThup0qVWdZzUvm56i5gvJXlKpUgirJxHsEDnzKatjrVShQGxOvNLxaxN529-eL8WbzViWHIASsIDvn4l4WY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF180Bp7_MpK2pkxaFLtvJqKPdtf6seCJTXbE1L-xeb9hsBGYGDEO1-vT1L-M5WDrH5iN1z8bV42WJTePbekcRxkWhtX1pQiVzH_ZExqXVW_ZkO1UDbP13fv0-af_qVv1jgeX8mVZ3eh_BOFBlD6sbcRwd2a_sdmKrfzk67Vr11CijJfZ9Ino-2sA51ug56A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXzL914cIEPOIRdaF8rRw3Cttfayv_rUJIlzjjzMCwLGH3hb2D5eQHpf1eytndYKwZJpyRLoR1fliVTQwBUxIwbcixZjKhBASl-qELLS8xSIavKlKZ1baeZLzyjF-h)

### Temporary & Non-Liver Factors
Mild elevations can sometimes be short-term and resolve on their own or after addressing a trigger. Intense exercise, muscle injury or breakdown (rhabdomyolysis), recent illness, or dehydration can raise enzymes—especially AST—even when the primary strain is outside the liver.⁠Mayo Clinic items.title: Less Common & Underlying Conditions
items.text: Autoimmune and bile duct conditions: Autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis, or primary sclerosing cholangitis. Inherited metabolic disorders: Hemochromatosis (excess iron storage), Wilson's disease (excess copper storage), or alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency. Other infections and conditions: Epstein-Barr virus (mononucleosis), cytomegalovirus, celiac disease, thyroid disorders, heart failure, bile duct blockages, or liver tumors.
